claim: Patchline detects schema-change and data-migration operations against NoSQL engines, not only relational databases. The inventory recognizes MongoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, and DynamoDB scripts from engine-specific signals and flags destructive operations such as dropping a collection or keyspace, unsetting fields, deleting an index, flushing a key space, or deleting a table. The gate proves Cassandra destructive-change detection against the real laaksomavrick/twitter-go repository fetched from GitHub, and proves the full five-engine matrix plus a no-false-positive rule for prose through deterministic unit tests.
